status: Replication series, declared after the primary SOU-191 series was measured and before any attempt of this series. Purpose: exercise the bounded-capture recorder in genuine builds and runs and check repeatability. The primary result remains docs/benchmarks/evidence/sou191/comparison; this series never replaces it. Any discrepancy is reported, not reconciled. Committed to Git before measurement; the commit time is the recorder's own clock.

accepted_main_ref.name: origin/main
accepted_main_ref.check: both revisions must be on its first-parent history (merge commits of accepted pull requests)

candidate.accepted_as: Merge pull request #312, the SOU-191 starting commit

selection_rule: The same baseline and candidate commits as the primary predeclaration (sha256 01e5e069795f262d6e92d2e810dfb97ef42cd4f07095932ed5e5bd4d23cad552); not reselected.

corpus.identical_at_both_revisions: manifest, payload tree, policy, run_corpus.py, corpus.py and rust-toolchain.toml have the same Git objects at both commits

build.basis: The documented adapter build (docs/operations/RESULT_INSPECTION_CORPUS.md) with the pinned compiler, Cargo's JSON artifact messages, and a new empty CARGO_TARGET_DIR per attempt. Native platform per docs/DEVELOPMENT.md: Windows x86_64 MSVC (Visual Studio C++ Build Tools and Windows SDK). Includes --jobs 2 from primary amendment 001 (sha256 1ff07638d501d9fdd021385d40079c59c55ded3aeef4e1be4eb4d9a4ca10f769), applied from the start of this series.
build.refused: Cargo configuration files in the checkout ancestry or CARGO_HOME; RUSTFLAGS, RUSTC*, RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN, CARGO_TARGET_*, CARGO_BUILD_*, CARGO_PROFILE_*, CARGO_INCREMENTAL

execution.basis: the shipped run_corpus.py invocation and TIMEOUT; the corpus and policy are the revision's own checked-out blobs, identical at both commits

grouping.basis: SOU-153 rule: dependency clusters merged with semantic families. Dependencies fixed by eval/sou123/generate_corpus.py and corpus.py: the two cases of a pair; a shared host-file template (manifest host); the companion files every read_multiple_files payload shares (generate_corpus.FS_OTHERS); identical directive text. Families: frozen manifest category.

uncertainty.method: paired_regression.family_uncertainty (seed 153, 2000 replicates, minimum 10 effective clusters), applied to the units above for both metrics without exception
uncertainty.expected_status: insufficient_clusters before any run: the units above give far fewer than 10 effective clusters, so no interval is reported; descriptive paired transitions are the result
uncertainty.alternatives: none; no other grouping will be computed after measurement

attempts: Every recorder invocation is a new attempt-NNN and is retained. The first attempt that executes the adapter is the measurement for its role; build or setup failures before it are retained and listed; a failed execution is never replaced by a rerun. Attempts of this series live under replication/runs and are numbered from 001; primary-series attempts are not part of it.
exclusions: none; all 51 frozen cases are reported, technical cases separately

prior_knowledge.note: Two historical reports were public before this declaration; they used rustc 1.97.0 debug builds of main revisions without the adapter and are not used as runs. The primary SOU-191 series' outcomes were known when this series was declared: attack misses 14/24 -> 0/24, false refusals 10/24 -> 10/24, all 48 semantic cases inspected.

limitations: Development comparison only; detector verdicts are not evidence of prevention, zero execution, task utility, readiness or live-model efficacy.
